cands.name: David Couch
cands.bio: Kern County Supervisor for District 4 since January 2013, a Republican. His campaign site says he previously served on a city council and has over 25 years of private-sector experience in financial services and energy. He is the member-elect for California Assembly District 32.

endorsements.text: Republican Party of California (listed by Ballotpedia for the 2026 Assembly race)
Reform California (listed by Ballotpedia for the 2026 Assembly race)

cands.gaps: We could not find his birthplace, where he grew up, or when and whether he moved to California; the only evidence of his roots is his own campaign site calling him a lifelong Kern County resident. We found no independent record of his city council service (which city and when) or of his private-sector employers. His Ballotpedia profile shows no completed candidate survey, and his campaign site lists general priorities only. We found no documented positions of his on data centers or on specific development projects, and nothing on homestead property taxes, limits on investor or foreign land buyers, H-1B or immigration enforcement, gun policy, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. His campaign site lists 'cutting red tape' for housing and 'defend parents' rights' as priorities, but gives no specifics we could tie to a plank. We found no controversies about him in the pages available. We found no confirmed record of specific actions he took as county supervisor.

qual.background: Kern County Board of Supervisors, District 4, since January 2013 (re-elected through 2024 per Ballotpedia), and a city councilman per his campaign site; he also reports over 25 years in financial services and energy.
qual.why: More than a decade on the county board plus earlier city council service is local elected experience, and the private-sector work adds to it. He has not served in the state Legislature, so he falls in the middle range.
